model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between coverage and the number of completions (k), with the x-axis representing the number of completions on a logarithmic scale ranging from $2^0$ to $2^8$, and the y-axis showing coverage values from 0.3 to 0.9. Four distinct models are compared: Llama-3B (blue circles), Llama-3B + FT (green triangles), Llama-1B (light blue squares), and Llama-1B + FT (light purple diamonds). All four lines show an increasing trend in coverage as the number of completions increases. Llama-3B starts at a coverage of approximately 0.43 and rises to about 0.9, while Llama-3B + FT begins at around 0.45 and reaches approximately 0.91. Llama-1B starts at about 0.32 and increases to roughly 0.85, and Llama-1B + FT begins at approximately 0.33 and reaches about 0.86. The Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT models consistently achieve higher coverage than their Llama-1B counterparts across all values of k.
